title: Armored Golems
body:
**Ever thought it was strange that iron armor gives you defense, but Iron Golems (who are completely made of iron) get none? This mod fixes that!**
 

Iron Golems now have 15 defense, equivalent to a full set of iron armor. This makes them a lot more useful for defending the village during the night and slightly more useful in raids, but powerful mobs such as the Warden will still destroy them just as easily.
